title: AraVISTA-Bench v1.1: Evidence-State Reasoning Benchmark for Selective Arabic RAG
description: AraVISTA-Bench v1.1 is a controlled Arabic benchmark for temporal evidence validity, directed evidence relations, query-conditioned evidence states, state-aware reranking, and selective actions in retrieval-augmented generation. The release contains 240 Arabic queries, 592 evidence passages, 960 QCES labels, 592 directed pairwise relation labels, frozen BM25/Dense-E5 predictions, and the implementation-aligned v1.1 notebook.
